description: This file defines the ZoneService interface, extending a generic entity service for managing zones within a geographic reference system. It declares methods for retrieving zones by code, adding descriptions to zones, and fetching zones based on country and language preferences.

classes.name: ZoneService
classes.description: A Java interface for managing zones, extending the generic SalesManagerEntityService with specific methods related to zones.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a zone by its unique code.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Associates a description with a zone, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Fetches a list of zones for a specified country and language.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieves a map of zones indexed by string identifiers for a specified language.
